014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.util.List;
017import java.util.Map;
018
019import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
020
021import java.util.function.BiFunction;
022
023// Experimental.
024public interface Reducer<C, T> {
025
026  // List, not Stream, for equality semantics and caching purposes.
027  // List, not Set, because it's much faster and reduction can take care of duplicates if needed
028  // C, not Predicate, because it may not be necessary to actually filter the list
029  // failureHandler will receive only those elements that could not be eliminated
030  // c is a pass-through used only during failure
031  public T reduce(final List<? extends T> elements,
032                  final C c,
033                  final BiFunction<? super List<? extends T>, ? super C, ? extends T> failureHandler);
034
035  public default T reduce(final Selectable<? super C, ? extends T> f,
036                          final C c,
037                          final BiFunction<? super List<? extends T>, ? super C, ? extends T> failureHandler) {
038    return this.reduce(f.select(c), c, failureHandler);
039  }
040
041  public default T reduce(final Selectable<? super C, ? extends T> f, final C c) {
042    return this.reduce(f.select(c), c, Reducer::fail);
043  }
044
045  public default T reduce(final List<? extends T> elements, final C c) {
046    return this.reduce(elements, c, Reducer::fail);
047  }
048
049  // A Reducer that simply calls its supplied failure handler.
050  public static <C, T> Reducer<C, T> ofFailing() {
051    return (l, c, fh) -> fh.apply(l, c);
052  }
053
054  // Probably overkill.
055  public static <C, T> Reducer<C, T> ofCaching(final Reducer<C, T> r) {
056    record Key<C, T>(List<T> l, C c) {};
057    final Map<Key<C, T>, T> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
058    return (l, c, fh) -> cache.computeIfAbsent(new Key<C, T>(List.copyOf(l), c), k -> r.reduce(k.l(), k.c(), fh));
059  }
060
061  // Default failure handler; call by method reference
062  public static <C, T> T fail(final List<? extends T> elements, final C c) {
063    return elements.stream().reduce((e0, e1) -> {
064        throw new AmbiguousReductionException(c, elements, "Cannot resolve: " + elements);
065      })
066      .orElseThrow(() -> new UnsatisfiedReductionException((Object)c));
067  }
068
069  // Convenience failure handler; call by method reference
070  public static <A, B, C> C returnNull(final A a, final B b) {
071    return null;
072  }
073
074}
